## Insights

- **Act:** Account & Access is 27% of incidents (106); password resets and lockouts alone are 85. Self-service password reset could deflect about 17 tickets a month.
- **Act:** 'Account locked again this week': 24 incidents, 10 of them within 7 days from Oct 27 (18 users). Open a problem record and review changes made just before Oct 27.
- **Act:** 'Outlook keeps prompting for password': 18 incidents, 9 of them within 7 days from Oct 15 (16 users). Open a problem record and review changes made just before Oct 15.
- **Act:** 'VPN disconnects every 30 minutes': 15 incidents, 8 of them within 7 days from Oct 12 (14 users). Open a problem record and review changes made just before Oct 12.
- **Act:** P2 High resolution SLA is 71.4% against a 95% target (10 of 14 met within 8 h); misses by group: Identity & Access 1, Desktop Support 1, Service Desk 1.
- **Watch:** First-contact resolution is 61.4% against a 70% target. Lowest: Hardware (30%), Network (43%). Add Tier 1 runbooks and KB coverage there.
- **On track:** 3.6% of incidents were reassigned two or more times (target ≤ 10%). Routing is healthy.
- **Watch:** 4 of 14 open tickets are older than 14 days (28.6%). Review on-hold reasons and vendor ETAs weekly.
- **Watch:** KB link rate is 53.8% (target 60%). Link the article you used on every resolution.
- **Watch:** CSAT averages 4.38 from 169 responses (target 4.5). Tickets that missed SLA average 3.3 versus 4.5 when SLA was met.
